authorityName: Approved Cylindrical Print Layout — Identical Artwork on Both Sides
scope: All cylindrical direct-print ELIMFILTERS filters using this approved visual system

brandArtworkAuthority.rule: This file is the sole official ELIMFILTERS logo source for cylindrical print artwork. Use the asset exactly as provided; do not redraw, recreate, restyle, alter proportions, substitute typography, or infer a replacement logo.

technologyArtworkAuthority.rule: Technology visual assets must be sourced exclusively from frontend/public/assets/. Do not recreate, redraw, restyle, substitute, or infer technology artwork when an authoritative asset exists there.

containerColorAuthority.productionNote: HEX/RGB are the digital master appearance values derived from the approved gray filter reference. A physical coating supplier must color-match the approved master sample/reference; do not substitute an arbitrary RAL or Pantone without physical validation.

installationRotationDirectionMarks.function: Indicate the installation tightening/rotation direction of the filter

containerAdaptiveLayout.rule: The approved cylindrical print layout must be proportionally adapted to the exact printable area of each filter container while preserving the approved hierarchy, relative spacing, alignment and visual balance.
containerAdaptiveLayout.priority: FIT THE AUTHORIZED ARTWORK TO THE CONTAINER; DO NOT FORCE THE CONTAINER TO MATCH ANOTHER SKU'S LAYOUT SIZE
containerAdaptiveLayout.notes: Large and small filters use the same authorized visual system, but artwork size and spacing must be proportionally fitted to the available cylindrical print area of the exact container.

workflow.purpose: Single source of truth for cylindrical ELIMFILTERS direct-print artwork
workflow.notes: For each filter, use the official logo only from frontend/public/assets/logo-elimfilters.png, use ELIMFILTERS DARK CHARCOAL #414141 as the container base-color authority, preserve the approved visual hierarchy, include the locked Installation Rotation Direction Marks in the upper print band below the metal rim, and change only SKU and technology according to category. Technology artwork must come from frontend/public/assets/. The complete layout must then be proportionally fitted to the exact printable area of that SKU's container. Physical can geometry, cap, base, thread presentation and proportions remain SKU-specific.
